title: Virtua Fighter
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター
overview:
The fierce battles of warriors gathered to become the strongest clash between reality and the virtual!

The arcade 3D fighting game Virtua Fighter comes to the Sega Saturn. Eight fighters, each with a different real-world martial art, enter the World Fighting Tournament to be named the strongest. Choose Akira, Pai, Lau, Wolf, Jeffry, Kage, Sarah or Jacky and fight one-on-one on a square ring using punch, kick and guard.

Win a round by emptying your opponent's health, by knocking them out of the ring, or by leading when time runs out. Mix strikes, throws and attacks on downed opponents, and beat all eight rivals to earn a final bout against the mysterious Dural.

- 1 or 2 players
- Eight fighters with hundreds of moves
- Replays of the action
- Memory backup support

最強となるため集結した戦士たちの熱き闘いが現実と仮想の間で交錯する！
